correctness.rationale: For Cr_n=K_{n,n} minus diagonal matching, every vertex on side A has an occupied neighbor in B iff |J|≥2, and symmetrically |I|≥2. If an outside A-vertex a_k is inserted in exchange for adjacent b_j, the new B-count falls to |J|−1; the exchange remains total dominating iff |J|≥3. Thus only I=[n] avoids that requirement; symmetrically J=[n] or |I|≥3. The two pairwise exclusive regimes are |I|,|J|≥3 and |I|=2,J=[n] or reverse. The polynomial is [sum_{k=3}^n C(n,k)x^k]^2+2C(n,2)x^{n+2} for n≥3. The first nonzero coefficient yields γ_st(Cr3)=5 (6 sets), γ_st(Cr_n)=6 for n≥4 (28 n=4, C(n,3)² n≥5). Direct independent swap-by-swap enumeration on every subset of Cr3..Cr6 agrees with the criteria and polynomial. No inference beyond enumerated range is needed because the swap criterion proves all n.
